notes.title: macOS Testers Wanted!
notes.content:
Hi all,
We're looking for people to help us test the macOS build of Frozen Synapse 2.
In order to participate all you need to do is opt in to the 'multiplatform_test' branch on Steam.

The game is playable on a late 2015 base model iMac and our minimum supported macOS version is Sierra.

Instructions:

1. Right click on 'Frozen Synapse 2' in your Steam Library and click on 'Properties'
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12680889/e64605fce57cfff429b61fc2740a9b2bc2dcd053.png
2. Click on 'BETAS' and select 'multiplatform_test' from the dropdown list
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12680889/55e7139560718427b88dcabcb81fc777dd4f7169.png
3. Click on OK and the game should start downloading. Once it's finished you should be able to play as normal.

Please report bugs and issues you find to jimmeh@mode7games.com

NOTE:
If you've already played a beta version of FS2 on macOS you may see this error when you try to launch it:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12680889/a59c01d45233975bbb8da3600dba2182560d48ed.png
We're looking in to how to fix it. Running this command in the terminal may work for you in the meantime 
[code]spctl --add ~/Library/Application\ Support/Steam/SteamApps/common/Frozen\ Synapse\ 2/FrozenSynapse2.app/[/code]

notes.title: November 13th Patch
notes.content:
Hi all!
Got some more bug fixes and improvements for you today.
Explosive unit AI is now more careful about killing its team mates		    Fixed crash on quit		    Fixed an issue with level generation		    Fixed an issue to do with retreating from the Hotel mission		    Fixed an issue where quick skirmishes end after the first turn		    Units no longer plant the bomb with their dying breath if they die inside the plant zone while carrying a bomb		    Now possible to play the tutorial from the main menu		    Fixed a crash caused by the AI

notes.title: November 2nd Patch
notes.content:
Lots of bugs fixes and other bits today!
		    Fixed some crashes to do with planning for ghost units		    Fixed being able to zoom out too far in Advance MP and Skirmish generators		    Improved wording of instructions for base defence missions and reduced timeout to 12 turns		    Miscellaneous crash fixes		    Fixed Advanced MP generator making blank Extermination Old School maps after a while		    Fixed issue with Shape Control		    When you kill a faction's HQ the faction will now die even if the leader isn't there		    Squad regen time is now shown in the selected object window on the main screen		    Now guaranteed to get a good unit after completing the tutorial mission		    Added new keyboard shortcuts (see Menu>Help>Hotkeys)		    "Stop" and "Engage on Sight" now have an icon for units when they use it		    Added some new help sections to Menu>Help and also a link to a tutorial video

notes.title: October 25th Patch
notes.content:
Small patch today to fix a couple of issues.
		    Fixed crash to do with planning for ghost units		    Added alert for not having an ammo contract before playing a story mission which requires it

notes.title: October 22nd Patch
notes.content:
Hi all!
Quite a few bug fixes today.
		    Fixed targetting icons revealing the locations of dark units		    Fixed bug with scoring Hostage games		    Fixed bug with scoring Secure games		    Failed missions now disappear from the contracts list		    Fixed issue where you could see the walls in locked rooms using the LOS line		    Minor typo fix		    Fixed issue where game wasn't ending if the faction leader had been killed		    Rebalanced car park mission to be slightly easier

notes.title: October 19th Patch
notes.content:
Hi all.
We've added a new way to play the single player in this update along with various bug and crash fixes.
		    Added 'Story Missions Only Mode'. Play through the campaign in an uninterrupted stream of encounters like in the original Frozen Synapse.		    Crash fixes		    Miscellaneous fixes

notes.title: October 10th Patch
notes.content:
Hi all!
Plenty of bug fixes today and a much requested feature.
		    Fixed an occasional campaign breaking bug		    Fixed issue where you could only send 1 squad out on missions or contracts		    Fixes to Instant Skirmish		    Ducked flamethrower/minigunner can no longer kill past cover		    Fixed flamethrower/minigunner weapon 'volumes' showing up in dark modes		    Game now shows the position of a player when they launch an arc weapon (e.g. grenade launcher) in dark mode		    Improvements to Bomb Defusal map generator		    Base Defends now have a time limit for the AI to win - if they can't do it in 20 turns or less then they lose		    Enabled 'cloud saves' on Steam	    

By the way we've moved the macOS and Linux builds to a new branch called 'multiplatform_test'. If you want to play the game on those platforms you will need to switch to that branch until we feel that they are ready for a general release.

notes.title: October 5th Patch
notes.content:
Hi all!
Got some bug fixes for you today.
		    Fixed another serious map generation/accessibility issue		    Removed aim handle from Advanced Game creation in multiplayer and Skirmish Generator in single-player		    Fixed a crash in Advanced Game/Skirmish Generator		    Fixed a bug that could cause you to fail a checkpoint contract if one of your own squads goes through it

notes.title: October 2nd Patch
notes.content:
Hi all!
We've just uploaded a patch for the game which fixes a number of glitches but also adds the Skirmish Generator and full match replays!
Here are the details:
		    NEW: Added an instant skirmish button and advanced skirmish generator		    NEW: Full match replay for finished missions or matches		    Fixed an issue with level generation causing inaccessible areas		    Fixed a desync/glitch to do with the pistol		    Trees and water are back		    Removed toxic grenade launcher units from some single player missions		    Various miscellaneous fixes

notes.title: September 28th Update
notes.content:
Hi all!
We've just put out another patch. Here are the salient details:

		    NEW: Added "City-style" maps for multiplayer Extermination matches (see Advanced Create to use them)		    BALANCE: Machine gun has been given a minimum focus-aim distance to nerf it slightly vs shotgunners		    Many level generation problems fixed		    Fixed several issues with inaccessible areas/trapped squads		    Fixed an issue with the mission "Join The Consensus"		    Various miscellaneous fixes	    

We've also put out a macOS version. This still requires some testing so we're not quite ready to say the game is available for the Mac yet.
There's also a Linux build but that currently has an issue which is preventing the game from starting. We intend to put up a working Linux build early on Monday.

Thank you for your patience and your bug reports. More to come!

notes.title: September 21st Update
notes.content:
Hi all!
We've just put out another patch which should fix a few more crashes and other issues which have come to light since release.

Fixed several exploits for Hostage gamesFixed issue with tutorial where you could get stuck at the rocket launcher stage and not progressFixed problem caused by rewinding and playing back a turnFixed units spawning outside of mission areaMisc. tutorial fixesFixed crash caused by dragging a 'ghost unit' around while the turn is playing backBalance change: you can no longer focus aim immediately after standing upFixed 'triangle rocket' crashMisc. bug fixesMisc. crash fixesSplashscreens look better at resolutions above 1920x1080

notes.title: Frozen Synapse 2 September 18th Update
notes.content:
Hi all!
We've just released an update for Frozen Synapse 2 which addresses a number of the most severe problems our users were reporting.
Fixed issue with focus/ignore zones causing crash
 Fixed a crash caused by selecting units in multiplayer
Added option for scaling the UI (for players with large monitors or high-DPI screens)
Added option for changing the zooming in/out speed for the city camera
Fixed crash caused by adding and deleting units when creating advanced multiplayer games
Fixed problem where your squad couldn't catch up to another squad which was on the move (e.g. intercept relic)
Fixed issue with Secure where attackers didn't have a location from which to spawn
Updated Bomb Defusal instructions
Fixed issues causing save corruption

We expect to have another update ready later this week.

Once again, thanks for being patient with these issues - we're working as hard as we can.

Also please keep sending us your bug reports. While we haven't had a chance to respond to every one yet they are all being read. Here is a guide on how to report a bug to us: https://steamcommunity.com/app/445020/discussions/0/1741094390469785486/

notes.title: Current Dev Roadmap
notes.content:
Hello all - here's our current plan...

Friday, today: several small bug fixes and minor rule changes to multiplayer modes

Sunday: 4k-supporting gui patch, some minor city bug fixes

Thursday: Some more significant city issues dealt with.

OSX and Linux versions and Skirmish Generator: Sept 28th (these will not interfere with ongoing bug fixing and improvements)

We're aware of some crashes in single player and some tutorial issues, and we're working on those for next week.

If you have crashes or similar, could you please mail support@mode7games.com with:

- dxdiag.txt (here are instructions on how to create one: https://support.microsoft.com/en-gb/help/4028644/windows-open-and-run-dxdiagexe)

- console.log (this file is in C:\Users\\AppData\Roaming\FrozenSynapse2\)

- your autosave, or any other relevant save, from this directory (this is in C:\Users\\AppData\Roaming\FrozenSynapse2\map\saves)

This will really help us out.

The response to the game has been great - we believe it in, and in its future potential so we're going to continue working hard on it.  Your support means a lot.

notes.title: Quick Update
notes.content:
Thought I'd let you know about something we're working on today.

This is a shot of a completely generated level - it conforms to the city map and has items in which have been taken there by the faction which owns it.

At the moment, Ian is working on procedurally generating patrol routes so we can use the stealth mechanics in any level, as well as a system to allow the player to deploy units in various positions at the start of the level.

We want to make sure that every generated level is exciting and relevant, that there are no dead turns and that you can use a full range of tactical options when approaching them...

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12680889/2c52eb372d7034a62c395f695af058c79c94079e.png
